summary: Frontend regression + focused verification for the 3 changes (mobile 3D fix, stats=145, brochure contact page). All acceptance criteria met.

verification_results.mobile_chip_opens_viewer_without_navigat: PASS - viewer opens with title 'MY DREAM NEST — 3D FLOOR PLAN'; URL unchanged
verification_results.mobile_card_tap_navigates_to_project: PASS - tap on card body navigates to /projects/my-dream-nest
verification_results.mobile_daynight_toggle_works: PASS - card-day-button click sets aria-pressed=true, no navigation
verification_results.desktop_hover_no_swap: PASS - hovering card at 1920px shows 0 card-3d-image overlays
verification_results.stats_flats_sold: PASS - stat-flats-sold counts to 145 after scroll-into-view

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectCard.jsx cleanly removed the hover-based 3D layer; all interactive controls (day/night buttons, 3D chip) correctly call e.preventDefault()+stopPropagation() to keep the outer <Link> from firing.
3D chip is properly implemented as a <button type='button'> — matches accessibility expectations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_36 verified: mobile 3D-touch bug fixed (no hover overlay in DOM, chip button is only entry to FloorPlanViewer), BUSINESS_STATS.totalFlatsSold=145 renders correctly (counter is IntersectionObserver-based, must scroll into view before asserting), stat-sft-delivered still '—', brochures for skylark & aurelia return valid PDF 200 with expected size. Regression on 4 key routes clean. Note: card-day-button-<slug> and card-night-button-<slug> are the actual BUTTON testids; card-day-image-<slug>/card-night-image-<slug> are the IMG elements — do not click IMG in tests as they fall through to the Link.
